title: Quasi-randomization-based inference for multivariate Mann-Whitney effects under random missingness
summary: Marginal Mann-Whitney effects are widely used across various fields of research, and extensions of this estimand have been developed in many directions in statistical methodology. In this paper, we focus on an extensions for repeated measurements and factorial designs subject to randomly missing data. In a previous work by Rubarth et al. (2022a), asymptotically correct tests were developed under the assumption of deterministic missing indicators.
